unit.why: A letter by R. Yehuda Zvi Hirsh of Rozdol urging the hasidim to support printing his father-in-law's Zohar commentary. Its only narrative element is a brief exchange: he asked the master to print it in his lifetime and was told of a tradition against printing during the author's life. That exchange is a reported saying, not a story.
unit.boundary_note: Final line 'מערכת ח. ש"ב הרה"ק מוהרי"א מזידיטשוב' is the heading of the next section (R. Yitzhak Isaac of Zhidachov), which begins in the next division.
